title: Find why a dashboard follow-up carried no earlier exchange (B-175-T04 step 2, S-6AAF)
goal: A follow-up question in the same dashboard conversation within 30 minutes gets the earlier exchange as context (and its taint), as it does in tests
acceptance: The cause is named from NERV-01 read-only evidence: the misato.request payloads (conversation, created) of S-DFCA and S-6AAF, and what misato.context returned or threw

A test reproducing that cause is committed failing first, then the fix; the B-175-T04 runtime test in test/mcp.test.ts (two dashboard chats, an earlier read then a tainted follow-up; added 2026-11-27, passes with a command MCP server) passes unchanged

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one read-only evidence query, one failing test, one fix in the context read path. Not a measurement.
